Calling this a 'premium PG' is honestly misleading. In less than a month of staying here, not a single day has passed when all basic amenities were working properly. Every day it’s a new issue for ex. electricity tripping across the flat, geyser not working for days, washing machines breaking down, lights going off, water issues, and poorly done repairs that actually make things worse instead of fixing them.

On top of this, things are getting stolen and no responsibility is taken. Complaints are brushed aside with zero accountability. The facilities promised at the time of signing are not being provided as stated, and the so-called agreement feels like a scam.

What’s most disturbing is the lack of safety, especially for girls. Faulty locks, poorly installed switchboards where anyone can get an electric shock, uncontrolled access, and no sense of security. Maintenance teams randomly show up late at night, sometimes entering rooms without proper intimation, as if residents have no right to privacy. It genuinely starts to feel less like a home and more like a place where you’re forced to adjust because you’ve already paid.

The people responsible keep saying they are “working on it,” but nothing actually gets resolved on time and no accountability is taken. There is no urgency, no consideration, and no professionalism but just empty assurances on repeat. Paying a premium amount for this kind of experience is mentally exhausting and deeply disappointing.

If you’re considering this place thinking premium pricing equals comfort, safety, and peace of mind then please think twice. Branding means nothing when basic facilities don’t work, belongings aren’t secure, safety isn’t prioritised, and residents are treated like an afterthought

featured_reviews.name: Nikesh Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reasonable value for the money given the location and its proximity to most places in the South. Your perception of the place would depend a lot on the kind of visitor you are. I'm writing this as an employee in a private organization.

Pros -
1. Location - it's in Parel, close to offices in Lower Parel, Elphinstone etc.
2. Pods were clean and the area was in general well maintained. Including the washroom
3. Well priced for a night.
4. Ample locked storage for visitors.

Cons -
1. Work area - there's no dedicated work area as such. You can work in the cafeteria but would have people coming in for meals and is in general small for the number of people staying there.

2. Canteen - I can't say anything about the food as I didn't have it there but around 8:15pm it was fully occupied because of the limited seating and so had to move to the terrace for dinner.

3. Reception - the check-in process wasn't too smooth. I was just expected to know what is where and while a lady did help me with the way to the bunker I'd have liked to be told about the facilities etc.

4. Connectivity - you don't get Airtel & Vodafone networks inside. Not atleast where my pod was. So I asked for WiFi and I was told that I can access WiFi only from reception, they wouldn't provide password of the other SSIDs that could have been accessed from the pod area. On the brighter side, that helped me go to sleep earlier than usual :)

5. Toiletries - most of the occupants here are students who are studying in colleges closeby and they have sort of been living at the hostel for a while. So even if you're there just for a day, you're expected to carry your towel, soap, shampoo, toothpaste etc. It's a hostel, not a hotel. :)
